title: The face peeler legend of the Peruvian Amazon

tellings.quote: there's the the faith face peeler legend goes back to the 80s, like the mid 80s. And it it doesn't go further than that.

plain: The Peruvian Amazon has a legend of a "face peeler", and it goes back only to the mid 1980s and no further, according to Tim Alberino. Alberino tells Michels this without naming a source. His point is that the story is recent, not an old local tradition.
